title: Isharani Baruah Finishes Runner-Up at Vietnam Open
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Isharani Baruah's performance in reaching the final highlights her growing potential on the international circuit.
summary: India's Isharani Baruah, ranked 39th, was defeated by unseeded Sarunrak Vitidsarn in the women's singles final of the Vietnam Open, losing 8-21, 15-21 in 34 minutes.

title: BAI Advanced Coaches Course Kicks Off Tomorrow in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course is crucial for enhancing the coaching standards across India, directly impacting player development from grassroots to elite levels.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is set to host a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14-23, 2026.

title: BAI Releases Regulations for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: The release of regulations for this key domestic event sets the stage for state teams to compete, fostering national talent and competition.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for participating state teams.

title: Junior National Coaching Camp Underway for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This coaching camp is vital for preparing India's promising young shuttlers for international competition at the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: An Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on preparing the junior squad.

title: Final Selection Trials Announced for BWF World Junior Championships
indian_angle: This announcement details the players qualified for the final selection trials, a critical step for India's junior talent aiming for the global stage.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the eligibility criteria and list of players qualified for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

title: BAI Adopts 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: The adoption of the 3x15 scoring system for junior domestic tournaments will significantly impact how young Indian players train and compete.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
